summary: Iteration 27 – Trash module + auto-contact + marketplace settlement. Backend pytest 7/7 PASS covering: (1) quote soft-delete → /api/trash listing (items/total/types/retention_days=30, days_left=30) → GET single, restore (409 duplicate handled), restore-again→404, permanent delete, empty trash; (2) bank-transaction inflow trash+restore balance hook — creating 123.45 inflow on non-integrated account bank_02 correctly increased balance +123.45; DELETE reverted -123.45, restore hook re-applied +123.45, purge left original balance intact; (3) expense (50 TRY paid on account) — delete decreased outflow effect (balance +50 vs pre), restore hook recreated bank tx and reduced balance again, verified end-to-end zeroed after purge; (4) product + contact + manual order trash — all three types have correct type_labels (Ürün / Stok Kartı, Cari Hesap, Sipariş), restore succeeded, deleting an already-invoiced order returns 400; (5) auto-contact on POST /api/orders channel='trendyol' creates contact with category 'Trendyol Müşterisi' & auto_created=true, second order with same phone but different name reuses same contact_id; POST /api/orders/auto-contacts returns status success; (6) settlement flow — PUT /api/integrations/ecommerce/ecom_trendyol/settlement-account with non-integrated account succeeds (settlement_account_name echoed), bogus id → 404, integrated account skipped (env has no integrated bank), convert 2×500=1000 trendyol order to invoice → response.settlement gross=1000, deductions≈270.99, net≈729.01; bank tx source='marketplace_settlement' created on target account; expense category 'Pazaryeri Komisyonu' with netted_in_settlement=true & no separate bank tx; profitability.settlement.count≥1 and trendyol.settlement_account_name set; reset PUT with account_id=null → subsequent convert-to-invoice returns settlement=null. All test data cleaned (Mongo direct for invoice/tx/expense/order/auto-contact; balance reverted by -net). Frontend Playwright verified: /trash sidebar link ('Çöp Kutusu 30 gün') and page (data-testid trash-page, trash-type-all, trash-search, trash-empty-state) — after seeded quote delete row appears, trash-search filters, trash-view opens trash-detail-modal, trash-restore triggers success toast ('Teklif geri getirildi: TKF-2026-0050 · TEST_UI cari.') and quote returns via GET /api/quotes; /orders → tab-profit reveals settlement-select-trendyol with all bank options, picking bank_01 shows 'Hakediş hesabı' success toast and settlement-active-trendyol badge, empty option resets ('Hakediş hesabı kaldırıldı; faturalar yalnızca ödendi işaretlenir.'); orders-auto-contacts-btn correctly hidden (no orderless contacts); /stock 'Pazaryeri Ürün Kârlılığı & Eşleştirme' product-profit-toggle opens panel, product-profit-row-* (2), unmatched-list shows 'Duvar Rafı Çizgili C8 …' Trendyol item with unmatched-product-select (10 stock options) and product-profit-days control — NOT matched.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py convert_order_to_invoice (line 4046) creates a bare contact fallback WITHOUT calling clean_doc/_ensure_order_contact patterns, so this fallback contact will not be marked auto_created and will not get the 'Pazaryeri Müşterisi' category. Only reached when _ensure_order_contact returns None (missing customer_name); acceptable but slightly inconsistent with new flow.

trash.py restore hook rollback (lines 118-122) deletes the primary doc but does not rollback related docs on hook failure — matches for related deletion is not surgical (uses in). Low risk since only trigger is HTTPException path.

server.py _post_marketplace_settlement stores order.settlement without company_id filter on subsequent settlement GET; profitability.settlement query filters by settlement.date only (line 3704) and could leak cross-company rows if multiple companies existed (single-tenant demo so fine).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_* quotes/orders/products/contacts/expenses/bank_txs and Mongo-direct invoice deletes cleaned; settlement account reset to None on ecom_trendyol; account balances restored to pre-test values.

Real Trendyol order 11571862893 and unmatched 'Duvar Rafı…' product preserved.
